Duolingo web style guide tokens + live specimens

The product fonts (duolingo-sans, feather) did not load from fonts/, so this page is drawn in Nunito. Text widths will not match the product crops. Put the three .woff2 files in fonts/ next to this page and serve the folder over http.

Extracted from the logged-in duolingo.com web app (light and dark) on 2026-09-25. Every colour, size and curve below is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json ({{COUNTS}}). Each specimen is live HTML and CSS built only from those properties, shown beside the matching crop of the real product in the current theme. Hover and press the buttons: the real :hover and :active rules are wired up.

Palette

All 300 colour names from the app's JS palette. Each chip shows the light value (left) and the dark value (right); the label ink is whichever of near-black or white has the higher WCAG contrast. In CSS: --palette-light-<name>, --palette-dark-<name>, and --c-<name> for the value in the current theme.

{{PALETTE}}

Colour roles

The semantic set, grouped as in tokens.json. Top of each chip is light, bottom is dark; the CSS variable resolves to the one for the current theme. background.scrim and border.onColor are black at 40% and 20%.

{{ROLES}}

Typography

Everything in the app is duolingo-sans; there is no 500 file, so weight 500 renders with the 400 face. feather (700 only) appears on the logged-out marketing page. Samples below use the real stack with each style's size, weight, line height, tracking and case.

Spacing

Padding, margin and gap values ranked by use. There is no 4px grid: 5, 10, 15 and 30 are as common as the even steps.

Shadows & the 3D lip

No shadow in the app has any blur. Depth is a solid shadow straight down (the "lip"): 4px under filled buttons, 2px border + 2px shadow under outline buttons and tiles, 8px under path nodes. Pressing moves the face down by the lip and removes the shadow.

filled: face + 0 4px 0 lip
pressed: down 4px, lip gone
outline: 2px border + 0 2px 0
thin: 1px border + 0 3px 0 1px

Buttons

One component, 24 captured variants. Anatomy: the <button> reserves the lip with a transparent bottom border; the face is a ::before layer at z-index:-1; the lip is its solid shadow. Hover is filter: brightness(1.1) on coloured faces and 0.9 on white faces (only under @media (hover:hover)). There is no focus ring anywhere in the button system. Product crops are Display P3 screen captures shown untagged, so they look slightly washed out beside the sRGB specimens; the hex values in tokens.json are the truth.

Form controls

Fields are recessed (polar fill, 2px swan border, 12px radius); choices are raised 3D faces (snow fill, 2px swan border plus a 2px swan lip) that turn iguana / blue-jay / whale when selected. Nothing has a hover or focus ring except the text input's macaw focus border.

Text input settings / profile

Label (heading-small, 700 20/24) 4px above a 48px field: polar fill, 2px swan border, 12px radius. Input 20/28 at 8px 14px padding. Focus turns the border macaw and reveals the 24px clear button (hare circle-x); password fields carry a macaw eye. Error: fire-ant border plus helper; disabled: polar border, hare text.

Overlays

Popovers, tooltips and menus share one shell: a snow bubble with a 2px swan border and 15px radius, and a 20x10 stem that is a 45deg rotated square clipped in half. Modals and drawers have no border or shadow: they sit on a black 40% scrim.

Popover top-bar dropdown, path node

Opens 8px below its trigger (12px on the path). Gems dropdown: 380px content at 24px 12px padding, 100px illustration, 12px gap, 700 24/26 title, wolf body, macaw link. Path node popover: 295px, 16px padding, unit-colour fill with no border, white 700 19/26.6 text and the white popover CTA.

App shell

Desktop frame at 1160px and wider: a 256px sidebar on the left, the path column in the middle and the right rail with the stat bar at the top. Below 1160px the sidebar collapses to an 88px icon rail; below 700px it is replaced by the mobile top and tab bars.

Sidebar navigation

256 x 797, padding 0 16px, 2px swan right border. Items 222 x 52 in an 8px-gap column: 2px transparent border, padding 4px 8px, 12px radius; 32px icon inside a 38px slot with a 20px gap; 15px bold uppercase label (0.8px tracking). Hover fills polar; the current page fills iguana with a 2px blue-jay border and a macaw label. In dark, polar and iguana are the same colour, so only the border marks the selected page.

Learn path

The path column is 480px wide at a 1200px viewport and 592px at 1384. Unit colours use *-always-light palette names, so banners, current and completed nodes and their popovers look the same in both themes; only locked faces, icons, rings and bubbles follow the theme.

Unit header

Sticky banner, full column width x 90, 16px padding, 13px radius, unit-colour fill. Left: back arrow and "SECTION 4, UNIT 12" (16px bold at 70%), then the 22px title. Right: GUIDEBOOK, a 148 x 54 transparent outline button whose border and lip are black at 20% (2px sides, 4px bottom), hover opacity(.8), press down 2px. The banner re-colours to the unit under it while scrolling.

Lesson

The /lesson screen: a 1000px top bar, a 600px challenge column, and a full-width 140px footer that turns into the feedback bar after CHECK. Pressing moves it down 2px and drops the lip. Selected is iguana face, blue-jay border and lip, whale text.
